scripts.registry:build: pnpm --filter @aeri-ui/ui exec shadcn build registry.json --cwd ../.. --output apps/web/public/r
scripts.registry:check: pnpm --filter @aeri-ui/ui exec shadcn registry validate registry.json --cwd ../..
scripts.registry:verify: pnpm run registry:check && pnpm run registry:build && tsx scripts/verify-registry-contract.ts
scripts.test:catalog: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm run catalog:budget && playwright test && pnpm run catalog:lighthouse
scripts.test: pnpm run test:catalog && pnpm run test:consumer
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check-types
